summary: The front page of the web app, which does nothing except send visitors to the dashboard.
purpose: Makes the root address of the site go straight to the dashboard.
why: The code comment says a real login check should go here later, and for now every visitor is sent to the dashboard.
how: It imports the redirect helper and, when the page is visited, immediately sends the browser to the dashboard address.

risks: There is no login check, so anyone who opens the site root reaches the dashboard. Protection depends on the dashboard or the layer above it.
debug: If the site root shows an error or loops, check that the dashboard route exists and that no other redirect points back here.
